message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, saya perlu memastikan Anda masuk ke akun Anda terlebih dahulu. Apakah Anda sudah memiliki akun? Jika belum, silakan daftar terlebih dahulu. Jika sudah, silakan berikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu saya jika Anda ingin saya membantu proses login). Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says in Indonesian: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" Means "Hello, size XS is not available, right?" They likely want to check availability of XS size. We need to authenticate? The tool is user_authentication_login. But we don't have credentials. The user didn't provide username/password. We cannot call the function. We should ask for credentials or clarify. Probably we need to ask for login.
